summary: Every course must be letter graded. The minor is one EE fundamental (5 units minimum), one of the four two-course sequences (EE 101A-B, EE 102A-B, EE 102A with ENGR 108, or EE 108 with EE 180, 8 units minimum), and four more EE courses at the 100 level or above, one of which may be CS 107 or CS 107E (12 units minimum), for at least 23 units. Your advisor checks that no seminar is used; transfer credit does not count.
